title: Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage: Covered-Day Census Settings
content:
Every tier of Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage counts covered days on one census basis. The settings are identical across Medicare Part A Without Supplemental Coverage, Medigap Plan A or B, Medigap Plan K, Medigap Plan L, Full-Coinsurance Medigap and QMB Medicaid Crossover.

| Setting | All six tiers |
|---|---|
| How a covered day is counted | Present at midnight: a day counts when the resident is in the center at the midnight census |
| Day of admission counts as a covered day | Yes |
| Day of discharge counts as a covered day | No |
| Leave-of-absence day (away at midnight, not admitted to a hospital) is a Part A covered day | No |
| Leave-of-absence day uses a benefit-period day | No |
| Day the resident is a hospital inpatient at midnight is a SNF covered day | No |
| Period for which covered days are booked and billed | The calendar month, closed early at the last covered date |

### Census truth table (all tiers)

| Where the resident is at midnight | Covered day | Uses a benefit day |
|---|---|---|
| In the center | Yes | Yes |
| Away on leave, not in a hospital | No | No |
| Hospital inpatient | No | No |

*Hypothetical illustration:* a resident admitted on the 19th and discharged on the 25th of a month, present at every midnight in between, has covered days the 19th through the 24th — six days — because the day of admission counts and the day of discharge does not.
